entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 3195919528989223040: position at J2016.0. Distance: Gaia DR3 parallax 199.6080 +/- 0.1208 mas (same row, RUWE 1.94): 5.01 pc, no zero-point correction; the RUWE is high, so the astrometry fits a single star poorly, and the parallax is used as published. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): -2240.085, -3421.809 mas/yr. Radial velocity from the same row.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 5,147 K and log g 4.54 (u1 0.615, u2 0.152): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
